name: A Moment of Bliss
source:
After spending a week vacation with a young woman named Petal, you come home at the request of your significant other. You and your partner, Rose, have been separated for a year, but have decided to try to work things out. 

The other two young ladies of the house, Petal and Bliss, are now both showing an unusual amount of affection towards you. Will you be able to work things out with Rose while also venturing into a sexual relationship with Petal and Bliss? 

[From [url=https://lockheart-novels.itch.io/a-moment-of-bliss]Itch.io[/url]]
